title: Galileo at SemEval-2020 Task 12: Multi-lingual Learning for Offensive Language Identification using Pre-trained Language Models
reasoning: The paper describes a system for detecting offensive language as part of a shared task competition. While detecting offensive speech relates to social harms, the paper's focus is on technical classification performance (F1 scores) using pre-trained language models rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or principles.
